title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to pad a string to a specified length with a character (GetPaddedString)
summary: GetPaddedString is a method in Business Central's StringConversionManagement codeunit that fills a string with a specified character until it reaches a desired length, supporting both left and right justification.
key_points: GetPaddedString pads strings by adding a character to reach a target length
Left justification adds padding characters to the right, right justification adds them to the left
If the original string exceeds the pad length, it is not truncated
The method is built into standard codeunit 47 StringConversionManagement

quotes.text: there is already a very simple method in the standard codeunit 47 StringConversionManagement that can do this: GetPaddedString().
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the built-in method developers should use instead of writing custom padding logic

quotes.text: If the original string is already longer than PadLength, GetPaddedString() does not truncate the string.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies important behavior: the method preserves longer strings without cutting them
